panels.title: WIND — load factor (% of MEL capacity)

targets.rawSql: WITH ns AS (SELECT station, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(latitude) DESC) AS rnk FROM bmu WHERE COALESCE(bmrs_fuel_type,'UNKNOWN') = 'WIND' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY station), cap AS (SELECT b.station AS station, SUM(m.cap) AS cap FROM (SELECT national_grid_bm_unit AS ngc, MAX(GREATEST(level_from, level_to)) AS cap FROM mels WHERE time_from >= $__timeFrom() AND time_from < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1) m JOIN bmu b ON b.ngc_bm_unit = m.ngc WHERE COALESCE(b.bmrs_fuel_type,'UNKNOWN') = 'WIND' AND b.latitude IS NOT NULL AND b.longitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.station) SELECT (h.bucket::timestamp + ((h.settlement_period - 1) * interval '30 min')) AS time, lpad(ns.rnk::text,3,'0') || ' ' || b.station AS metric, NULLIF(100.0 * SUM(h.b1610_mwh * 2) / NULLIF(c.cap,0), 0) AS value FROM b1610_hh_cagg h JOIN bmu b ON b.ngc_bm_unit = h.bmu JOIN cap c ON c.station = b.station JOIN ns ON ns.station = b.station WHERE COALESCE(b.bmrs_fuel_type,'UNKNOWN') = 'WIND' AND b.latitude IS NOT NULL AND b.longitude IS NOT NULL AND h.bucket >= $__timeFrom()::date AND h.bucket <= $__timeTo()::date AND (h.bucket::timestamp + ((h.settlement_period - 1) * interval '30 min')) >= $__timeFrom() AND (h.bucket::timestamp + ((h.settlement_period - 1) * interval '30 min')) < $__timeTo() GROUP BY time, b.station, c.cap, ns.rnk ORDER BY time, metric
